detail.body:
### Purpose

**Scope: ROCm only, Kimi-K3 only, opt-in.** All model changes are in
`vllm/models/kimi_k3/amd/`, which is only loaded on ROCm, and the new path only
runs for Kimi-K3's attention-residual layers. It is off by default
(`VLLM_KIMI_K3_AMD_PREFILL_SP_MIN_TOKENS=0`). NVIDIA, other models and
CUDA-graph decode are unaffected.

With TP, every rank repeats the same per-token work (attention-residual mixing,
MoE router, latent down-projection, top-k) on all tokens. For eager steps with
at least `VLLM_KIMI_K3_AMD_PREFILL_SP_MIN_TOKENS` tokens (1024 recommended),
this PR shards the residual stream over tokens instead, padded to a multiple of
TP:

- Each block output all-reduce becomes a reduce-scatter plus an all-gather
before the next block, so communication volume is unchanged.
- Attention-residual mixing, the router and top-k run on the local shard only.
- The latent-MoE tail reduce-scatters its output over tokens instead of
all-reducing it.

It is off with PP, with DP > 1, during graph capture, and when aux hidden
states are requested (EAGLE drafters).

The NVIDIA Kimi-K3 path has something similar (`use_sequence_parallel` in
`nvidia/model.py`), but it only turns on with expert parallelism plus DP > 1
or DeepGEMM MegaMoE, for every step. This PR covers plain TP on ROCm, and only
for long prefill steps.

### Test Plan

- New `tests/models/kimi_k3/test_amd_prefill_sp.py`: the MoE tail, regular and
token-sharded, matches the replicated result at TP4/TP8 for both the
`ColumnParallelLinear` and replicated up-projection layouts. The routing
all-gather and the gather of pre-quantized FP8 activations (data plus per-token
scale) are bit-exact, padded gather/scatter round-trips, and the enable
conditions are covered.
- With the existing Kimi-K3 AMD runner, KDA/MLA direct-return and sequence
parallel tests: 68 passed on `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly` (vllm 77154ca61).
- End to end: 8x MI355X, Kimi-K3 MXFP4, TP8, `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly`
with and without `VLLM_KIMI_K3_AMD_PREFILL_SP_MIN_TOKENS=1024`,
`vllm bench serve`, random data, 1K output tokens. The agentic TP8 + DCP8
config (prefix caching, CPU KV offload, 24576 batched tokens) also serves
160/160 requests with and without the flag.

### Test Result

Δ vs stock nightly (same image, 2026-10-14); throughput is (input + output)
tok/s/GPU.

| Input | Conc. | Throughput | TTFT   |
| ----- | ----- | ---------- | ------ |
| 10K   | 32    | +4.4%      | -15.1% |
| 50K   | 32    | +8.5%      | -10.4% |
| 200K  | 8     | +7.4%      | -9.5%  |

An earlier 8-point sweep of the previous revision gave a geomean of +6.1%, with
1K prompts within run-to-run noise.

Accuracy matches stock (measured on the previous revision; the sharded path now
uses the same latent all-reduce as stock): GSM8K 5-shot 0.989 vs 0.982 (mean of
3 runs), passkey retrieval up to 190K 0.95-1.00 vs 0.95, and first-token top-1
agreement 20/20 on real-text prompts from 2K to 190K.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Token-sharded Kimi-K3 prefill on ROCm must equal the replicated path.
+
+Each rank ends up holding only its own token rows, so the multi-GPU checks
+compare every rank's shard with the matching rows of the all-reduce result.
+"""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch.multiprocessing import spawn
+
+from tests.utils import (
+    ensure_current_vllm_config,
+    init_test_distributed_environment,
+    multi_gpu_test,
+)
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+from vllm.forward_context import set_forward_context
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fusion.quant_activation import QuantizedActivation
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.layernorm import RMSNorm
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import ColumnParallelLinear, ReplicatedLinear
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.base_config import QuantizeMethodBase
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import (
+    kFp8DynamicTokenSym,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd import sp
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.latent_moe_runner import ROCmLatentMoERunner
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.linear import (
+    KimiDecoderLayer,
+    KimiMoE,
+    KimiRoutedOutputTransform,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.transformers_utils.configs.kimi_linear import KimiLinearConfig
+from vllm.utils.network_utils import get_open_port
+from vllm.v1.worker.workspace import init_workspace_manager
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_rocm(),
+    reason="Token-sharded Kimi-K3 prefill is only wired up on ROCm",
+)
+
+HIDDEN_SIZE = 7168
+LATENT_SIZE = 3584
+TOP_K = 16
+NUM_EXPERTS = 896
+EPS = 1e-5
+DTYPE = torch.bfloat16
+
+
+def _build_transform(
+    device: torch.device, tp_world: int, rank: int, row_sharded: bool
+) -> tuple[KimiRoutedOutputTransform, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Returns the transform and the full up-projection weight."""
+    norm = RMSNorm(LATENT_SIZE, eps=EPS).to(device=device, dtype=DTYPE)
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    norm.weight.data.copy_(1 + 0.1 * torch.randn_like(norm.weight))
+    weight = torch.randn(HIDDEN_SIZE, LATENT_SIZE, device=device, dtype=DTYPE)
+    weight /= LATENT_SIZE**0.5
+
+    up_proj: ColumnParallelLinear | ReplicatedLinear
+    if row_sharded:
+        # The layout KimiMoE uses under TP: each rank stores its output rows.
+        up_proj = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            LATENT_SIZE,
+            HIDDEN_SIZE,
+            bias=False,
+            gather_output=True,
+            params_dtype=DTYPE,
+            prefix="routed_expert_up_proj",
+        ).to(device=device)
+        rows = HIDDEN_SIZE // tp_world
+        up_proj.weight.data.copy_(weight[rank * rows : (rank + 1) * rows])
+    else:
+        up_proj = ReplicatedLinear(
+            LATENT_SIZE,
+            HIDDEN_SIZE,
+            bias=False,
+            params_dtype=DTYPE,
+            prefix="routed_expert_up_proj",
+        ).to(device=device)
+        up_proj.weight.data.copy_(weight)
+    return KimiRoutedOutputTransform(norm, up_proj, row_sharded=row_sharded), weight
+
+
+def _tail_runner(
+    transform: KimiRoutedOutputTransform, tp_world: int
+) -> ROCmLatentMoERunner:
+    runner = object.__new__(ROCmLatentMoERunner)
+    attrs = {
+        "routed_output_transform": transform,
+        "_up_proj_preshard": transform.row_sharded,
+        "_up_proj_shard_size": HIDDEN_SIZE // tp_world,
+        "_logged_sharded_tail": False,
+        "moe_config": SimpleNamespace(
+            tp_size=tp_world,
+            ep_size=1,
+            is_sequence_parallel=False,
+            skip_final_all_reduce=False,
+        ),
+    }
+    for name, value in attrs.items():
+        object.__setattr__(runner, name, value)
+    return runner
+
+
+def _all_reduced(tensor: torch.Tensor, group) -> torch.Tensor:
+    reduced = tensor.clone()
+    dist.all_reduce(reduced, group=group)
+    return reduced
+
+
+def _check_sharded_tail(device: torch.device, tp_world: int, rank: int) -> None:
+    """For both up-projection layouts, the column-parallel tail matches the
+    replicated result, and its token-sharded variant returns this rank's rows."""
+    for row_sharded in (True, False):
+        _check_tail_layout(device, tp_world, rank, row_sharded)
+
+
+def _check_tail_layout(
+    device: torch.device, tp_world: int, rank: int, row_sharded: bool
+) -> None:
+    transform, weight = _build_transform(device, tp_world, rank, row_sharded)
+    runner = _tail_runner(transform, tp_world)
+    group = get_tp_group().device_group
+
+    for iteration, num_tokens in enumerate((tp_world, 2 * tp_world, 64)):
+        torch.manual_seed(100 * iteration + rank + 1)
+        routed = 0.01 * torch.randn(num_tokens, LATENT_SIZE, device=device, dtype=DTYPE)
+        shared = torch.randn(num_tokens, HIDDEN_SIZE, device=device, dtype=DTYPE)
+
+        expected = F.linear(
+            F.rms_norm(
+                _all_reduced(routed, group),
+                (LATENT_SIZE,),
+                transform.norm.weight,
+                EPS,
+            ),
+            weight,
+        )
+        expected.add_(_all_reduced(shared, group))
+        rows = num_tokens // tp_world
+
+        full = runner._shard_up_proj_tail(routed.clone(), shared.clone(), None)
+        actual = runner._shard_up_proj_tail(routed, shared, None, token_sharded=True)
+
+        torch.testing.assert_close(full, expected, atol=8e-2, rtol=3e-2)
+        assert actual.shape == (rows, HIDDEN_SIZE)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            actual, expected[rank * rows : (rank + 1) * rows], atol=8e-2, rtol=3e-2
+        )
+
+
+def _check_routing_gather(device: torch.device, tp_world: int, rank: int) -> None:
+    """Packed routing survives the gather bit-exactly and in rank order."""
+    rows = 5
+    gen = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(7)
+    weights = torch.rand(tp_world * rows, TOP_K, device=device, generator=gen)
+    ids = torch.randint(
+        NUM_EXPERTS, (tp_world * rows, TOP_K), device=device, generator=gen
+    ).to(torch.int32)
+    shard = slice(rank * rows, (rank + 1) * rows)
+
+    got_weights, got_ids = sp.all_gather_routing(weights[shard], ids[shard])
+
+    assert got_weights.dtype == weights.dtype and got_ids.dtype == ids.dtype
+    torch.testing.assert_close(got_weights, weights, atol=0, rtol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(got_ids, ids, atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+
+def _check_padded_gather_scatter(
+    device: torch.device, tp_world: int, rank: int
+) -> None:
+    """Token counts that do not divide TP round-trip through the padded shards."""
+    group = get_tp_group().device_group
+    for num_tokens in (tp_world * 8 - 3, tp_world * 8 + 1, tp_world * 8):
+        padded = -(-num_tokens // tp_world) * tp_world
+        rows = padded // tp_world
+        gen = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(num_tokens)
+        full = torch.randn(padded, 64, device=device, generator=gen)
+        full[num_tokens:] = 0
+
+        gathered = sp.gather_tokens(full[rank * rows : (rank + 1) * rows], num_tokens)
+        torch.manual_seed(rank + 1)
+        partial = torch.randn(num_tokens, 64, device=device)
+        scattered = sp.scatter_tokens(partial)
+
+        torch.testing.assert_close(gathered, full[:num_tokens], atol=0, rtol=0)
+        expected = F.pad(_all_reduced(partial, group), (0, 0, 0, padded - num_tokens))
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            scattered, expected[rank * rows : (rank + 1) * rows], atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5
+        )
+
+        data = full.to(current_platform.fp8_dtype())
+        scale = torch.rand(padded, 1, device=device, generator=gen)
+        mine = slice(rank * rows, (rank + 1) * rows)
+        quantized = QuantizedActivation(
+            data[mine], scale[mine], DTYPE, torch.Size((rows, 64)), kFp8DynamicTokenSym
+        )
+        for keep, expected_rows in ((num_tokens, num_tokens), (None, padded)):
+            got = sp.gather_activation(quantized, keep)
+            assert isinstance(got, QuantizedActivation)
+            assert got.orig_shape == (expected_rows, 64)
+            assert got.orig_dtype == DTYPE and got.quant_key == kFp8DynamicTokenSym
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                got.data.view(torch.uint8),
+                data[:expected_rows].view(torch.uint8),
+                atol=0,
+                rtol=0,
+            )
+            torch.testing.assert_close(got.scale, scale[:expected_rows], atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+
+def _check_shard_routed_moe(device: torch.device, tp_world: int, rank: int) -> None:
+    """A small latent KimiMoE routed on the token shard returns this rank's
+    rows of the unsharded layer, with the gathered top-k replacing routing."""
+    init_workspace_manager(device)
+    config = KimiLinearConfig(
+        hidden_size=512,
+        hidden_act="silu",
+        rms_norm_eps=EPS,
+        # At least the 256 per rank that KimiMoE would otherwise pad up to.
+        moe_intermediate_size=256 * tp_world,
+        num_experts=32,
+        num_experts_per_token=4,
+        num_shared_experts=1,
+        routed_expert_hidden_size=256,
+        latent_moe_use_norm=True,
+        use_grouped_topk=True,
+        num_expert_group=1,
+        topk_group=1,
+    )
+    vllm_config = VllmConfig()
+    vllm_config.compilation_config.static_forward_context = {}
+    torch.set_default_dtype(DTYPE)
+    with set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config), torch.device(device):
+        moe = KimiMoE(config, prefix="model.layers.1.mlp", layer_idx=1)
+    assert moe.experts.token_shardable
+
+    # Same seed on every rank: replicated weights match across ranks, and each
+    # rank's TP shard is just a slice of some consistent full weight.
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        for param in moe.parameters():
+            if param.dim() == 1:
+                param.copy_(1 + 0.1 * torch.randn_like(param))
+            else:
+                param.copy_(torch.randn_like(param) / param.size(-1) ** 0.5)
+    for module in moe.modules():
+        quant_method = getattr(module, "quant_method", None)
+        if isinstance(quant_method, QuantizeMethodBase):
+            quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(module)
+
+    rows = 6
+    num_tokens = tp_world * rows
+    torch.manual_seed(1)
+    hidden = torch.randn(num_tokens, config.hidden_size, device=device, dtype=DTYPE)
+    mine = slice(rank * rows, (rank + 1) * rows)
+    layer = SimpleNamespace(mlp=moe)
+    with set_forward_context(None, vllm_config, num_tokens=num_tokens):
+        expected = moe(hidden)
+        actual = KimiDecoderLayer._run_moe_sp_shard_routed(layer, hidden[mine])
+
+    assert actual.shape == (rows, config.hidden_size)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected[mine], atol=8e-2, rtol=3e-2)
+
+
+_CHECKS = {
+    "sharded_tail": _check_sharded_tail,
+    "routing_gather": _check_routing_gather,
+    "padded_gather_scatter": _check_padded_gather_scatter,
+    "shard_routed_moe": _check_shard_routed_moe,
+}
+
+
+def _worker(local_rank: int, world_size: int, port: str, check: str) -> None:
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{local_rank}")
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(device)
+    with ensure_current_vllm_config():
+        init_test_distributed_environment(
+            world_size, 1, local_rank, port, local_rank=local_rank
+        )
+        _CHECKS[check](device, world_size, local_rank)
+
+
+def _run_ranks(check: str, tp_size: int) -> None:
+    spawn(
+        _worker,
+        args=(tp_size, str(get_open_port()), check),
+        nprocs=tp_size,
+        join=True,
+    )
+
+
+@multi_gpu_test(num_gpus=4)
+def test_sharded_tail_tp4_matches_replicated_rows() -> None:
+    _run_ranks("sharded_tail", 4)
+
+
+@multi_gpu_test(num_gpus=8)
+def test_sharded_tail_tp8_matches_replicated_rows() -> None:
+    _run_ranks("sharded_tail", 8)
+
+
+@multi_gpu_test(num_gpus=4)
+def test_routing_gather_tp4_is_exact() -> None:
+    _run_ranks("routing_gather", 4)
+
+
+@multi_gpu_test(num_gpus=8)
+def test_padded_gather_scatter_tp8() -> None:
+    _run_ranks("padded_gather_scatter", 8)
+
+
+def _run_shard_routed_moe(
+    tp_size: int, use_aiter: bool, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+) -> None:
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER", str(int(use_aiter)))
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE", str(int(use_aiter)))
+    _run_ranks("shard_routed_moe", tp_size)
+
+
+@multi_gpu_test(num_gpus=4)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("use_aiter", [False, True])
+def test_shard_routed_moe_tp4_matches_unsharded_rows(
+    use_aiter: bool, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+) -> None:
+    _run_shard_routed_moe(4, use_aiter, monkeypatch)
+
+
+@multi_gpu_test(num_gpus=8)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("use_aiter", [False, True])
+def test_shard_routed_moe_tp8_matches_unsharded_rows(
+    use_aiter: bool, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+) -> None:
+    _run_shard_routed_moe(8, use_aiter, monkeypatch)
+
+
+class _Router(torch.nn.Module):
+    def select_experts(self, hidden_states, router_logits, **kwargs):
+        return "routed"
+
+
+def test_pre_routed_overrides_then_restores() -> None:
+    router = _Router()
+    topk = (torch.ones(2, TOP_K), torch.zeros(2, TOP_K, dtype=torch.int32))
+
+    with sp.pre_routed(router, topk):
+        assert router.select_experts(hidden_states=None, router_logits=None) is topk
+    assert router.select_experts(None, None) == "routed"
+    assert "select_experts" not in router.__dict__
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError), sp.pre_routed(router, topk):
+        raise RuntimeError
+    assert router.select_experts(None, None) == "routed"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("calls", [0, 2])
+def test_pre_routed_requires_exactly_one_route(calls: int) -> None:
+    router = _Router()
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError), sp.pre_routed(router, ("w", "i")):
+        for _ in range(calls):
+            router.select_experts(None, None)
+    assert router.select_experts(None, None) == "routed"
+
+
+def test_pre_routed_keeps_an_instance_override() -> None:
+    router = _Router()
+    router.__dict__["select_experts"] = lambda *args, **kwargs: "patched"
+
+    with sp.pre_routed(router, ("w", "i")):
+        assert router.select_experts(None, None) == ("w", "i")
+    assert router.select_experts(None, None) == "patched"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "min_tokens,tp_size,num_tokens,has_residual,has_aux,last_rank,dp_size,expected",
+    [
+        (1024, 8, 16384, False, False, True, 1, True),
+        (1024, 8, 1024, False, False, True, 1, True),
+        (0, 8, 16384, False, False, True, 1, False),
+        (1024, 1, 16384, False, False, True, 1, False),
+        (1024, 8, 1016, False, False, True, 1, False),
+        (1024, 8, 16381, False, False, True, 1, True),
+        (1024, 8, 16384, True, False, True, 1, False),
+        (1024, 8, 16384, False, True, True, 1, False),
+        (1024, 8, 16384, False, False, False, 1, False),
+        (1024, 8, 16384, False, False, True, 2, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_should_shard(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+    min_tokens: int,
+    tp_size: int,
+    num_tokens: int,
+    has_residual: bool,
+    has_aux: bool,
+    last_rank: bool,
+    dp_size: int,
+    expected: bool,
+) -> None:
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_KIMI_K3_AMD_PREFILL_SP_MIN_TOKENS", str(min_tokens))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sp, "get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size", lambda: tp_size)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        sp, "get_pp_group", lambda: SimpleNamespace(is_last_rank=last_rank)
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sp, "get_dp_group", lambda: SimpleNamespace(world_size=dp_size))
+    assert sp.should_shard(num_tokens, has_residual, has_aux) is expected

+"""Token-sharded residual stream for Kimi-K3 prefill on ROCm.
+
+With TP, every attention / MLP output all-reduce is replaced by a
+reduce-scatter over tokens, and the (per-token) attention-residual mixing runs
+on the local token shard only; the shard is all-gathered right before each
+attention / MLP input. Communication volume is unchanged (AR = RS + AG), while
+attn_res traffic and the block-residual bank shrink by the TP size.
+
+In latent-MoE layers the router gate, latent down-projection and top-k also run
+on the token shard (their outputs are all-gathered instead of being recomputed
+on every rank), and the column-parallel up-projection tail reduce-scatters
+its output instead of all-reducing it.
+
+Enabled by ``VLLM_KIMI_K3_AMD_PREFILL_SP_MIN_TOKENS``; see :mod:`vllm.envs`.
+"""
+
+import contextlib
+from collections.abc import Iterator
+from dataclasses import replace
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm.distributed import (
+    get_dp_group,
+    get_pp_group,
+    get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size,
+    tensor_model_parallel_all_gather,
+    tensor_model_parallel_reduce_scatter,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fusion.quant_activation import QuantizedActivation
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import GroupShape
+
+
+def should_shard(num_tokens: int, has_residual: bool, has_aux_layers: bool) -> bool:
+    """Whether this forward runs with a token-sharded residual stream.
+
+    The residual stream is padded to a multiple of the TP size, so every step
+    above the threshold shards; otherwise the unsharded path's larger
+    activations would exceed the profiled peak.
+    """
+    min_tokens = envs.VLLM_KIMI_K3_AMD_PREFILL_SP_MIN_TOKENS
+    return (
+        min_tokens > 0
+        and get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size() > 1
+        and num_tokens >= min_tokens
+        and not has_residual
+        and not has_aux_layers
+        and get_pp_group().is_last_rank
+        and get_dp_group().world_size == 1
+        and not torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
+    )
+
+
+def gather_tokens(shard: torch.Tensor, num_tokens: int | None = None) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """All-gather the token shards, dropping the TP padding rows if
+    ``num_tokens`` is given."""
+    out = tensor_model_parallel_all_gather(shard, dim=0)
+    return out if num_tokens is None else out[:num_tokens]
+
+
+def gather_activation(
+    shard: torch.Tensor | QuantizedActivation, num_tokens: int | None = None
+) -> torch.Tensor | QuantizedActivation:
+    """:func:`gather_tokens` that also accepts a per-token quantized
+    activation, gathering its data and scale and rebuilding it."""
+    if isinstance(shard, torch.Tensor):
+        return gather_tokens(shard, num_tokens)
+    key = shard.quant_key
+    assert key.scale.group_shape == GroupShape.PER_TOKEN and key.scale2 is None
+    data = gather_tokens(shard.data, num_tokens)
+    return replace(
+        shard,
+        data=data,
+        scale=gather_tokens(shard.scale, num_tokens),
+        orig_shape=torch.Size((data.size(0), *shard.orig_shape[1:])),
+    )
+
+
+def scatter_tokens(partial: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Pad unpadded per-token partial sums back and reduce-scatter them."""
+    pad = (-partial.size(0)) % get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+    if pad:
+        partial = F.pad(partial, (0, 0, 0, pad))
+    return tensor_model_parallel_reduce_scatter(partial, dim=0)
+
+
+def all_gather_routing(
+    topk_weights: torch.Tensor, topk_ids: torch.Tensor
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """All-gather this rank's top-k over tokens in one collective."""
+    w_bytes = topk_weights.contiguous().view(torch.uint8)
+    packed = torch.cat([w_bytes, topk_ids.contiguous().view(torch.uint8)], dim=1)
+    packed = tensor_model_parallel_all_gather(packed, dim=0)
+    nw = w_bytes.size(1)
+    return (
+        packed[:, :nw].contiguous().view(topk_weights.dtype),
+        packed[:, nw:].contiguous().view(topk_ids.dtype),
+    )
+
+
+@contextlib.contextmanager
+def pre_routed(router: Any, topk: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]) -> Iterator[None]:
+    """Make ``router.select_experts`` return ``topk`` for the duration. The
+    body must route exactly once, so the caller's placeholder router logits
+    are never read."""
+    calls = 0
+
+    def select_experts(*args, **kwargs) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        nonlocal calls
+        calls += 1
+        return topk

+    shadowed = router.__dict__.get("select_experts")
+    router.select_experts = select_experts
+    try:

+    finally:
+        if shadowed is None:
+            del router.select_experts
+        else:
+            router.select_experts = shadowed
+    assert calls == 1, f"expected one select_experts call, got {calls}"
